title: Proactive standby validation and tiered region routing orchestration
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: During regional outages or capacity skews we rely on warm-standby regions, but we currently lack a standardized, low-risk way to validate that a standby region is actually ready to take production traffic at the required SLOs. Existing heuristics are either too conservative (slow failover) or too coarse (miss degraded KV cache priming / incompatible model variants).

Goal: Implement a proactive standby validation subsystem and tiered routing orchestration that: (1) runs non-disruptive readiness probes that exercise critical paths (request routing, KV cache warmup, model-variant compatibility, session affinity), (2) exposes a standardized readiness score for each region/tier, and (3) integrates with smart routing policies to enable fast, safe failover and tiered routing based on business priority.

Scope: engineering work to add probe runners, readiness scoring, policy hooks in the routing layer, graceful session draining handoffs, contract checks for model variant compatibility, and documentation/runbooks. This ticket covers orchestration for multi-region warm standby validation and the routing policy integration; follow-ups will cover adaptive autoscaling tweaks and UI surfaces in Console.
acceptance_criteria: Readiness probe runner deployed in staging that performs: control-plane API check, inference loop (short gen), KV prefix warmup, model-variant compatibility check, and latency sample collection
Regions expose a readiness score (0-100) and component breakdown (control, model, cache, infra) via the control-plane API
Routing policy can use readiness score + tier rules to automatically shift traffic with configurable thresholds and cooldowns
Failover drills (simulated regional outage) succeed with <2x error spike and meeting 99th percentile latency target for 95% of requests in the routed tier
Playbook and runbook added to runbooks/ with step-by-step manual takeover, rollback, and verification checks
Automated canary test in CI that validates a newly onboarded region achieves readiness score >= 85 before being eligible for tier-0 routing
implementation_plan: Design readiness probe specification and define component metrics (control, model, cache, network)
Implement probe runner service (stateless) that can be scheduled per-region and emits metrics to Observability via OTLP
Create readiness scoring function and store results in control-plane state (read via routing decisions API)
Extend smart routing policy expression language to reference readiness_score and tier attributes
Add pre-failover dry-run mode: route 1% synthetic traffic to standby to validate live response without impacting customers
Integration tests and staged rollout: internal staging -> canary regions -> global rollout
test_plan: Unit tests for readiness score computation and model-variant contract checks
E2E test: schedule probe runner in staging, assert readiness components and final score are present
Chaos test: simulate node-level packet loss in primary region and verify automated tiered routing reduces cross-region tail latency within SLO
Canary dry-run in production: 1% synthetic traffic for 1 hour; assert no customer-facing errors and KV cache hit-rate gap < 10%
Post-failover validation script to run after any automated failover and record results for audit
rollout_plan: Deploy probe runner to 2 staging regions and validate metrics for 48h
Enable routing policy integration in staging routing controller and run simulated failovers
Canary enable in a low-TPS production region with dry-run traffic for 24h
If canary passes, enable policy with conservative thresholds in secondary regions (tier-1) for 7 days
Gradually promote eligible regions to tier-0 routing by lowering thresholds and removing dry-run after two successful drills
Communicate schedule to SRE, support, and customer success before each production promotion
monitoring_and_alerts: Create dashboard: readiness_score per region, component breakdown, probe latency distribution, kv-warmup hit-rate
Alert (P0) when readiness_score drops >30 points in under 5 minutes for a tier-0 region
Alert (P1) when model-variant compatibility check fails for an active model variant in any region
Add audit logs for automated routing changes including reason, previous state, and reverting action
Synthetic CI job to run failover drill weekly and surface regressions to channel #routing-incidents
